svg.title: The critics
svg.desc: Nine critics, each a fresh agent with one question: Accuracy, is every claim true? Clarity, will they follow it? Pacing, can they keep up? Sync, is it shown when it is said? Visuals, is every frame readable? Consistency, one name for one thing? Engagement, would they keep watching? Decision, can they make the call? Grounding, is the evidence real? The agent that made the video never judges it.
svg.text: The agent that made the video never judges it.

g.text: Is it shown when it’s said?
